new: Backup now just starts: nothing to answer before the copy. A first backup asks at most one thing, which drive, and only when it can't tell.
The report has the options afterwards: make a second copy, put two cards on one report, change how your shoots are named, and pick a different drive for next time.
A new home page with your posts first: Turn your shoots into posts and My posting queue on top, backing up a card and the editing queue below.
My vault: one post kit that draws from every shoot. Search your photos and clips, make a reel from any of them, and see everything in it.
The monthly recap counts each reel once, however many times you pressed Make.
